decisions: C799: original809 failed because CSharp flow/direct RuntimeMouseEvents cases invoked an obsolete main-only guard. Remove those two checks while preserving Source input, arity, move ownership and target capabilities. Original809 now compiles and links on Windows and Linux; direct-call function control and unchanged literal-capacity negatives pass.

SLG effects.disallowedMainOnlyCall independently rejects exactly sys.input.mouse.Source.events inside a lexical function. Remove only this obsolete declaration predicate. Function LLVM call lowering already recognizes module/sys.input.mouse + Source + events and emits the affine producer without a main-only fallback.

Six CSharp constants own worker helpers, lifecycle helpers, Windows/Linux platform functions and platform declarations. All original SLG instruction lines match those constants after whitespace and existing #0 markers; lifecycle contains two raw literal blocks, both included. Preserve queue bounds, cancellation, worker shutdown, join-before-destroy and partial startup cleanup.

Split the common body at its existing lifecycle boundary, keeping each constant within16384 characters. Reuse the existing generated NativeRuntime region and preserve function emission order. No target, ownership or input relaxation.

C800: CSharp EmitTryExpression evaluates the operand then branches on the Result tag, returns the error with lexical cleanup, and extracts the success payload. Normal SLG functions and structured regions already use emitResultPropagation with the function owner. The shared stream dispatcher omitted this canonical AST82 IR30 case. Reuse that exact helper in emitEntryControlExpression; keep stop IR30 AST62 separate. The pure non-stream probe passes both compilers, while the new stream probe passes CSharp and reproduces undefined v6 in Native35. No scheduler barrier or source syntax workaround.

C801: Canonical mouse_event.slg Source.events declares Console. Native effect masks already consume this declaration. CSharp RequiredEffects previously consumed Effects only for User/UserBlock. Return nonempty declared effects for all committed kinds before the existing legacy fallback; preserve ordinary empty functions and existing intrinsic-kind effects where declarations omit uses. Exact unchanged missing-Console input now rejects with the same diagnostic. Keep original invalid source path/bytes unchanged and create a separate positive with uses Console. No SLG effect weakening.

cumulativeProducerBudget.justification: New reproduced C800 omission fixed at the actual dispatcher; C801 CSharp admission aligned to declared effects. Focused CSharp behavior passed before this build; no repeat merely for more diagnostics.
